vol-convexity.thesis: Oil, metals, and the rates curve already carry the policy-and-supply shock in linear markets: Brent, gold, SOFR versus March 2027, and USDCAD leave little unpriced directional edge. Uncertain timing of the next oil or policy impulse would normally favor bounded-risk optionality, but this freeze lists no premium, implied volatility, or strikes. With the book flat and no markable convex payoff, standing aside dominates inventing a vol surface.
